listing:
(grammar (start root) (matching longest) (settling tokens precedence dynamic ambiguity))
(extra (ref comment))

(scanner context (tokens fragment) (operations (if (valid fragment) (then (while (next (literal %20)) (do (skip (literal %20)))) (consume (repeat1 (class negated (char %7B) (char %3E) (char %21)))) (emit fragment))) fail))

name: zero width scanner tokens retain following internal extras

(rule comment token (seq (literal %21) (repeat1 (class negated (char %3E)))))

name: composite extras retain internal horizontal separators
